encounters.hazard: Flickering lights reveal shadowy figures crawling on walls

pickup.name: Corrosive Acid Vial
pickup.effect: Deal 30 damage to enemies with 30% chance to corrode armor

encounters.trigger: Discover a journal entry indicating a containment chamber deeper in the facility

enemy.name: Sludge Warden
enemy.weakness: Corrosive Acid Vial (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Pulsating bioluminescent fungi release spores that impair vision

pickup.name: Moonblossom Herb
pickup.effect: Create a potion that deals 50 damage and temporarily reveals enemy weaknesses

encounters.trigger: Destroy a security panel to unlock the final chamber containing the corrupted alchemist

boss.name: The Corrupted Alchemist
boss.victory_condition: Use Moonblossom Herb to create a destabilizing potion that explodes on contact

level.objective: Survive three escalating encounters while uncovering the facility's dark secrets, culminating in a confrontation with the corrupted creator of the lab's experiments.
level.reward: Ancient Alchemy Formula (unlocks new potion recipes)

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights and cold drafts that sap player stamina

pickup.name: Blazing Core
pickup.effect: Increases fire damage by 25% and unlocks a fiery explosion ability

encounters.trigger: Defeating the wraith causes a sealed iron door to unlock, revealing a path forward

enemy.name: Molten Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Cold damage (requires using the Blazing Core to power a nearby furnace)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling debris and molten lava pools

pickup.name: Frost Shard
pickup.effect: Unlocks ice projectile attacks and a 10-second frost field

encounters.trigger: Destroying the sentinel causes the ceiling to collapse, revealing the boss's chamber

enemy.name: Infernal Overlord
enemy.weakness: Frost Shard's ice projectiles (must freeze the boss's core to finish it)

encounters.hazard: Explosive gas vents and hallucinogenic fog that lowers accuracy

pickup.name: Eternal Ember
pickup.effect: Permanent 30% fire damage boost and grants immunity to fire-based status effects

encounters.trigger: The boss fight begins only after the sentinel's destruction, with the Overlord emerging from a fissure in the floor

boss.name: Infernal Overlord
boss.weakness: Frost Shard's ice projectiles (must freeze the boss's core to finish it)
boss.victory_condition: Freeze the core with Frost Shard then strike with Inferno Staff

level.objective: Survive three encounters and defeat the Infernal Overlord, using pickups from prior encounters to exploit weaknesses
level.reward: Eternal Ember, granting permanent fire damage boost and fire immunity

level.setting: Dark, decaying corridors of a haunted psychiatric hospital with flickering lights, creaking floors, and distant whispers.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing floor panels that trigger if the player lingers too long.

pickup.name: Shadow Crystal
pickup.effect: Increases stealth by 30%, allowing the player to move undetected for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Wraith unlocks a hidden door leading to the main hallway.

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights create blind spots; enemy patrols in patterns.

pickup.name: Void Amulet
pickup.effect: Absorbs enemy attacks for 5 seconds, then releases a damaging shadow burst.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Mutant Guard reveals a sealed door to the director's office, now unlocked.

encounters.hazard: Explosive gas leaks that ignite if the boss is damaged too quickly.

pickup.name: Shadowblade Upgrade: Void Edge
pickup.effect: Increases player weapon damage by 50% against shadow-weak enemies.

encounters.trigger: Boss fight begins only after the Void Amulet is equipped.

boss.name: Corrupted Director
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by using the Void Amulet to trigger a shadow burst during its vulnerable phase.

level.objective: Navigate the asylum, defeat three enemies, and dismantle the corrupted director using pickups obtained from prior encounters.

level.setting: A decaying, overgrown forest with twisted trees, fog-shrouded ruins, and the remnants of a forgotten village. The air is thick with the scent of decay, and distant howls echo through the trees.

encounters.hazard: Environmental: Fog reduces visibility by 50%.

pickup.name: Corrupted Totem
pickup.effect: Disrupts spectral energy fields (used in the second encounter)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Corrupted Wolf reveals a hidden path through the trees, leading to a decaying village square.

encounters.hazard: Environmental: Periodic collapses of unstable buildings.

pickup.name: Shattered Amulet
pickup.effect: Weakens the boss's protective aura when activated

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Spectral Hunter, the amulet glows, revealing a hidden entrance to the forest's heart.

encounters.hazard: Environmental: Toxic mist (reduces healing by 50% unless Shattered Amulet is active).

pickup.name: Forest Guardian's Heart
pickup.effect: Restores 50% player health and grants temporary invincibility (10 seconds)

encounters.trigger: Using the Shattered Amulet during the boss fight reveals a weak spot (the heart), which must be targeted with the Ancient Longbow.

boss.name: Forest Warden (Corrupted)
boss.weakness: Shattered Amulet (activates a 10-second window to strike the heart with the Ancient Longbow)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by exploiting the heart weakness during the amulet's active period.

level.objective: Survive and defeat the corrupted entities to reclaim the Forest Guardian's Heart and escape the desolate forest.
level.reward: Forest Guardian's Heart (grants temporary invincibility and healing)

level.setting: The Cursed Glade - a dense, misty forest with ancient ruins and spectral phenomena

encounters.hazard: Fog reduces visibility by 50%

pickup.name: Cursed Relic
pickup.effect: Unleash dark energy attacks

encounters.trigger: Player enters the misty forest, triggering the Wraith's appearance

encounters.hazard: Collapsing stone pillars

pickup.name: Soul Amulet
pickup.effect: Absorb enemy essence to heal player

encounters.trigger: Player uses Cursed Relic to break the Golem's stone armor, revealing the temple entrance

encounters.hazard: Teleporting spectral chains

pickup.name: Eldritch Tome
pickup.effect: Unlocks advanced necromancy spells

encounters.trigger: Player activates the Soul Amulet at the crypt's altar, summoning the Hollow King

boss.name: Hollow King
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Hollow King using the Soul Amulet to drain his essence

level.objective: Retrieve the Eldritch Tome from the crypt while surviving spectral threats

level.setting: A collapsing, blood-soaked psychiatric hospital with flickering lights, collapsing ceilings, and echoing screams. Walls are lined with rusted medical equipment, and the air smells of antiseptic and decay.

encounters.hazard: Ceiling collapses periodically, dropping debris. Enemy lunges erratically, slamming into walls to create shockwaves.

pickup.name: Fuel Canister
pickup.effect: Ignites flammable materials, deals 150 fire damage when used as a projectile.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Mutant Warden, the player finds the Fuel Canister near a broken elevator. Using it ignites a fuse, causing the elevator to descend to the next area.

encounters.hazard: The floor is covered in spilled chemicals. The Shadow Stalker phase-shifts, leaving afterimages that explode on contact.

pickup.name: Corrupted Shard
pickup.effect: Disrupts enemy energy fields, making them vulnerable to physical attacks for 5 seconds.

encounters.trigger: The Shadow Stalker's defeat leaves the Corrupted Shard embedded in a wall. The player must retrieve it to unlock the door to the boss chamber.

boss.name: The Surgeon
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Surgeon's energy core by using the Corrupted Shard during its shielded phase.

level.objective: Survive the collapsing asylum, defeat three enemies, and destroy the Surgeon. Each enemy's defeat reveals a tool to progress.
level.reward: Unlocks the 'Berserker's Resolve' ability: 20% damage reduction for 10 seconds after killing an enemy.

level.setting: A serene, mist-shrouded forest surrounding an abandoned monastery. The exterior appears peaceful, but the interior is filled with flickering candlelight, echoing footfalls, and the distant sound of a bell tolling every 30 seconds.

encounters.hazard: The spirit's touch causes temporary hallucinations (player loses 10% accuracy for 10 seconds).

pickup.name: Rusted Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks a sealed door in the monastery's east wing

encounters.trigger: After defeating the spirit, the key unlocks a hidden passage leading to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Shattered Mirror
enemy.weakness: Light (requires Lantern pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Broken mirrors reflect the player's movements, drawing the enemy's attention.

pickup.name: Holy Symbol
pickup.effect: Reflects 30% damage from the boss fight

encounters.trigger: Defeating the mirror entity with the lantern reveals a hidden chamber containing the Holy Symbol, which emits a faint glow visible in the final chamber.

enemy.name: The Warden's Shadow
enemy.weakness: Holy Symbol (from second encounter) + Stone Maul (player's weapon)

encounters.hazard: The boss periodically summons spectral chains that reduce player movement speed by 50%.

pickup.name: Monastery Relic
pickup.effect: Permanently increases player's weapon damage by 5

encounters.trigger: The Holy Symbol's glow disrupts the boss's shadow form, revealing its vulnerability to the Stone Maul's enchanted core.

boss.name: The Warden's Shadow
boss.weakness: Holy Symbol (from second encounter) + Stone Maul (player's weapon)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss while holding the Holy Symbol, which amplifies the Stone Maul's damage by 30%.

level.objective: Investigate the monastery's disappearances, with the final goal of retrieving the Monastery Relic from the chapel.

level.setting: A whimsical, eerie carnival at midnight, with colorful tents, cracked mirrors, and malfunctioning rides. The air is filled with distorted laughter and the scent of burnt cotton candy.

encounters.hazard: The player must navigate a hall of mirrors that warp their vision, forcing them to rely on the Prism's light to find the real enemy.

pickup.name: Glimmering Lens
pickup.effect: Enhances the player's illusion magic, revealing hidden weaknesses in subsequent encounters.

encounters.trigger: The player shatters the Mirror Spirit, causing the carousel nearby to creak to life.

encounters.hazard: The carousel spins uncontrollably, forcing the player to dodge its moving parts while using the Glimmering Lens to spot the horse's mechanical weak point.

pickup.name: Whimsy Wand
pickup.effect: A powerful illusionist tool that can create explosive illusions or disrupt enemy magic.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the horse causes the carnival's main tent to burst open, revealing the twisted Ringmaster.

encounters.hazard: The Ringmaster summons ghostly performers to distract the player, requiring precise timing with the Whimsy Wand to avoid being overwhelmed.

pickup.name: Carnival Crown
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of the player's health and grants a temporary invincibility shield.

encounters.trigger: The player defeats the Ringmaster, causing the carnival to collapse into a pile of confetti and broken toys.

boss.name: The Ringmaster
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Ringmaster's illusion core using the Whimsy Wand while dodging his summoned phantoms.

level.objective: Escape the haunted carnival by defeating the three twisted attractions and the Ringmaster.
level.reward: Carnival Crown (restores health and grants invincibility)

level.setting: A crumbling brass-and-iron workshop in the heart of a derelict steampunk city, with broken machinery, leaking steam pipes, and unstable platforms. The air is thick with smoke, and random mechanical failures cause explosions and falling debris.

encounters.hazard: Explosive steam vents activate after Golem-13's defeat, forcing the player to navigate a collapsing walkway to the next area.

pickup.name: Steam Injector
pickup.effect: Increases weapon damage by 30% for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Steam Injector found, which unlocks access to the steam pipeline network.

encounters.hazard: The spider triggers collapsing pipe sections, forcing the player to dodge debris while using the Steam Injector to create pressure blasts.

pickup.name: Gyro Stabilizer
pickup.effect: Reduces weapon recoil and improves aim accuracy for 20 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating Spider-7 causes the pipeline to rupture, flooding the next chamber with steam and revealing the boss's lair.

boss.name: Clockwork Titan (The Overlord)
boss.victory_condition: Use Gyro Stabilizer to aim at the Titan's core during its third phase, when its armor is temporarily weakened by steam explosions.

level.objective: Reach the central reactor chamber, defeat the Clockwork Titan, and stabilize the factory's collapsing systems.
level.reward: Blueprints for a 'Turbine Core' upgrade, granting permanent +15% weapon damage and +25% health.

level.setting: A forgotten underground workshop beneath a Victorian city, filled with rusted gears, fog, and cryptic mechanical symbols.

encounters.hazard: Steam vents and shifting gears block the path until the spider is disabled.

pickup.name: Quicksilver Acid Vial
pickup.effect: Corrosive damage +30%

encounters.trigger: Defeating the spider causes the gears to realign, revealing a hidden steam tunnel.

encounters.hazard: Pressure plates activate the guardian if the player hesitates.

pickup.name: Chrono-Regulator Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the boss chamber's time-locked doors

encounters.trigger: Inserting the Chrono-Regulator Key into a terminal disables the guardian's armor, revealing its core.

encounters.hazard: The warden's movements are synchronized with a ticking clock.

pickup.name: Golem Core Blueprint
pickup.effect: Allows the player to target the boss's weak point

encounters.trigger: Destroying the warden's core with the acid vial activates a hidden elevator to the boss chamber.

boss.name: The Chrono-Golem
boss.weakness: Quicksilver Acid Vial (from Encounter 1) + Golem Core Blueprint (from Encounter 3)
boss.victory_condition: Corrode the golem's core using the vial while targeting its weak point with the blueprint.

level.objective: Reach the heart of the workshop and dismantle the Chrono-Golem to stop its time-manipulating experiments.
level.reward: A working Chrono-Engine (upgrades player weapon by 50% damage)

level.setting: Glimmerhaven - A floating city of brass and steam, with clockwork birds, glowing gas lamps, and gears suspended in the sky. The alchemist navigates through a labyrinthine workshop, a steam vent, and a gear-filled chamber to confront a rogue inventor's creation.

encounters.hazard: A dancing mechanical bear with spinning gears blocks the path to the steam vent. Its movements are slow and rhythmic.

pickup.name: Vial of Acid
pickup.effect: Can be used to corrode metal enemies

encounters.trigger: Destroy the Gearbeast's core gear with the Wrench to unlock the steam vent.

encounters.location: Steam Vent of the Glimmering Core

enemy.name: Steam Serpent
enemy.weakness: Vial of Acid (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: A serpentine automaton made of copper pipes spouts scalding steam, creating a fog that obscures the path.

pickup.name: Mechanical Gear
pickup.effect: Can be inserted into machinery to disable traps

encounters.trigger: Corrode the Steam Serpent's valve with the Acid Vial to redirect steam and open the gear chamber.

encounters.hazard: A spider-like automaton with legs of polished brass weaves webs of sticky tar to impede progress.

pickup.name: Battery Core
pickup.effect: Provides a temporary shield when inserted into the player's gear

encounters.trigger: Insert the Mechanical Gear into the spider's central mechanism to short-circuit its movements.

boss.name: Golem King (The Inventor's Folly)
boss.weakness: Vial of Acid (specific pickup from first encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Corrode the Golem King's brass plating to expose its core, then use the Vial of Acid to destroy it.

level.objective: Navigate the mechanical hazards, defeat the three enemies to unlock the final chamber, and destroy the Golem King by exploiting weaknesses tied to your pickups and weapons.
level.reward: A functional automaton companion and a blueprint for creating self-repairing potions.

level.setting: A derelict airship factory deep in the industrial sprawl of Ironhold. The air is thick with steam, and flickering gas lamps cast jagged shadows across rusted gears and conveyor belts. The player must navigate through the factory's core to stop a rogue engineer's automaton army.

encounters.hazard: A collapsing ceiling blocks the path to the next area until the Sentinel is defeated.

pickup.name: Corrosive Fluid Canister
pickup.effect: Can melt metal armor for 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Sentinel, the player uses the Corrosive Fluid Canister to dissolve the ceiling's metal grating, revealing a steam duct leading to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Steam Golem
enemy.weakness: Corrosive Fluid Canister (pickup from previous encounter)

encounters.hazard: A pressurized steam vent activates when the Golem is agitated, dealing 5 damage per second to the player.

pickup.name: Signal Jammer
pickup.effect: Disables automated turrets for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Golem releases a trapped Signal Jammer from its core. The player must use it to disable turrets in the next area before proceeding.

encounters.hazard: The Turret's laser grid activates if the player fails to disable it, dealing 15 damage per second.

pickup.name: Titan Core Keycard
pickup.effect: Unlocks the boss chamber's security door

encounters.trigger: After disabling the Turret, the player finds the Titan Core Keycard embedded in its control panel. The keycard is required to unlock the final chamber.

boss.name: Steam Titan
boss.weakness: Titan Core Keycard (pickup from third encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Use the Keycard to overload the Titan's core, then finish it with a final strike from the Plasma Wrench.

level.objective: Reach the factory's core and destroy the Steam Titan before the automaton army reaches Ironhold.
level.reward: Blueprints for a Gadget: "Steam Disruptor" (increases damage against mechanical enemies by 30%)

enemy.name: Iron Warden
enemy.weakness: Lightning strikes to its exposed gear core.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling tiles and steam vents

pickup.name: Capacitor Core
pickup.effect: Increases lightning damage by 30% and stores energy for 15 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Player must activate a broken gear mechanism to unlock the corridor, releasing the Iron Warden.

enemy.name: Steam Colossus
enemy.weakness: Sonic resonance from the Capacitor Core disrupts its steam pressure.

encounters.hazard: Explosive steam pipes and floor traps

pickup.name: Resonance Crystal
pickup.effect: Unlocks a secondary attack mode: sonic shockwaves (uses 50% of stored Capacitor energy).

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Iron Warden, the Capacitor Core powers a nearby machine, awakening the Steam Colossus.

enemy.name: Chrono-Warden
enemy.weakness: Lightning modulated by the Resonance Crystal disrupts its time-loop core.

encounters.hazard: Time-loop anomalies (duplicate enemies, reversed gravity zones)

pickup.name: Chrono-Disruptor
pickup.effect: One-time use: bypasses the Chrono-Warden's time-loop invulnerability.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Steam Colossus triggers a time-loop collapse, summoning the Chrono-Warden.

boss.name: Chrono-Warden
boss.weakness: Lightning strike charged with Resonance Crystal energy (requires 50% Capacitor energy + Resonance Crystal).
boss.victory_condition: Use the Chrono-Disruptor to bypass invulnerability, then strike the time-loop core with charged lightning.

level.objective: Navigate the collapsing factory, collect pickups, and dismantle the Chrono-Warden's time-loop core.

level.setting: A decaying, overgrown clockwork city where time fractures the environment, revealing glimpses of the past and future. Rusty machinery, shattered glass, and flickering gas lamps create a haunting atmosphere.

encounters.hazard: Broken automaton parts fall from the ceiling when the Golem is damaged.

pickup.name: Time Crystal
pickup.effect: Temporarily enhances the Chronogun's time distortion field by 50%.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Golem unlocks a hidden portal in the rubble, revealing a temporal rift leading to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: The ground shifts between past and future states, causing unstable terrain.

pickup.name: Chrono Core
pickup.effect: Restores 30% of the player's health and grants immunity to temporal stasis for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Chrono-Parasite stabilizes the rift, allowing passage to the final chamber.

encounters.hazard: The boss warps time, summoning ghostly duplicates of itself that must be prioritized.

pickup.name: Eternal Gear
pickup.effect: Permanently increases Chronogun damage by 20% and grants a 10% chance to freeze enemies on hit.

encounters.trigger: The boss's defeat restores temporal stability to the city, unlocking the Eternal Gear as a reward.

boss.name: Time Warden
boss.victory_condition: Use the Chrono Core to disrupt the Time Warden's temporal field, then land a critical hit with the Chronogun.

level.objective: Navigate the fractured city, defeat three temporal threats, and restore balance to the time-locked ruins.

level.setting: Eerie underground factory with rusted gears, flickering gas lamps, and leaking steam. Fog clings to broken machinery and ghostly figures flicker in the distance.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing platforms; avoid falling into acid pools.

pickup.name: Cracked Geode Core
pickup.effect: Disrupts steam pressure when used as a tool

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Golem releases a trapped gas cloud, awakening the next enemy.

enemy.name: Steam Wraith
enemy.weakness: Pressure Valves (Disrupt with Cracked Geode Core)

encounters.hazard: Explosive steam vents activate randomly, dealing area damage.

pickup.name: Resonant Crystal
pickup.effect: Overloads mechanical cores when used as a weapon attachment

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Wraith's pressure valves causes a tremor, revealing the path to the boss.

boss.name: Corrupted Geomancer Automaton
boss.victory_condition: Use the Resonant Crystal to overload the core while dodging its seismic attacks.

level.objective: Navigate the factory, defeat enemies to obtain pickups, and use them to weaken the final boss.
level.reward: Steamforged Gauntlets (Increases player weapon damage by 25%)

level.setting: A serene, sunlit garden filled with brass automatons tending to mechanical flora. Gears rotate gently in the air, and steam vents emit soft hisses as the environment hums with peaceful energy.

encounters.hazard: A broken gear trap blocks the path forward until the Steam Core Fragment is used.

pickup.name: Steam Core Fragment
pickup.effect: Unlocks the path to the next encounter by powering a deactivated gear trap.

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Brass Golem and insert the Steam Core Fragment into the gear trap to proceed.

enemy.name: Clockwork Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Steam Core Fragment (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: A locked gate guarded by the Clockwork Sentinel, which only opens when its internal steam system is disrupted.

pickup.name: Celestial Gear
pickup.effect: Temporarily increases player weapon damage by 50% for the final boss fight.

encounters.trigger: Use the Steam Core Fragment to overload the Sentinel's steam core, then defeat it to obtain the Celestial Gear.

encounters.hazard: The guardian's corrupted core emits a damaging aura that weakens the player over time.

pickup.name: Purified Heart Crystal
pickup.effect: Restores 100% player health and grants a permanent +2 damage boost to Lightbringer.

encounters.trigger: Equip the Celestial Gear to bypass the guardian's defenses. Defeating it reveals the Purified Heart Crystal.

boss.name: The Chrono-Guardian (Corrupted Timekeeper)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Chrono-Guardian's core with the Celestial Gear-enhanced Lightbringer while avoiding its time-loop attacks.

level.objective: Restore balance to the steampunk garden by purifying the corrupted Chrono-Guardian.
level.reward: Purified Heart Crystal (permanent stat boost) and access to the next level's clockwork city.
